observations: Photo 0 shows a white and black PlayStation 5 Slim console standing vertically on a wooden surface, with a white and black DualSense controller placed in front of it.
Photo 1 shows the same console standing horizontally on the same surface, with the DualSense controller in front.
The console has a glossy finish with a black vertical stripe down the center, characteristic of the PS5 Slim.
The background includes a framed picture on the wall with a music player interface showing 'Love Yourz' by J. Cole.
The console appears to be in good condition with no visible cracks or damage in the photos.
The controller looks clean and undamaged.

identity.kind: PlayStation 5 Slim console with DualSense controller

claims.claim: Clean PS5 slim with a pad
claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 show the console and controller in good condition with no visible damage or dirt.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal damage
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on and showing the PS5 home screen, or a photo of the power light and boot screen.

risks.risk: Controller may not function properly (e.g., buttons, analog sticks, or Bluetooth)
risks.proof: Video of the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses and analog stick movement.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit
risks.proof: Photo of the console's serial number and model label, or a video showing the console's system information screen.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and showing the PS5 home screen.
Video of the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses and analog stick movement.
Photo of the console's serial number and model label.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
